name: ACM Europe Winter School on Social Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia
note: SoRAIM aims to bring together researchers from complementary fields — such as computer vision, speech and audio processing, affective computing, and human-robot interaction — who share a common interest in social robotics and socially intelligent systems. The school fosters cross-disciplinary exchange and discussion, both through formal courses given by internationally recognised experts and through the many opportunities for informal interaction in a relaxed mountain setting.
